faq.q: Which handwriting fonts and languages are available?
faq.a: Nine English handwriting fonts (Caveat, Kalam, Indie Flower, Patrick Hand, Shadows Into Light, Architects Daughter, Homemade Apple, Dancing Script, Gloria Hallelujah) plus four Indian-language fonts: Devanagari for Hindi/Marathi, Bengali, Tamil and Telugu. Ink can be blue, black or blue-black, and paper can be plain, single-ruled, double-ruled, four-line, grid or dotted grid.

faq.q: What does the Realism slider actually do?
faq.a: It controls randomised per-character variation using a seeded generator: baseline wobble per line, slight size and rotation changes per letter, small vertical jitter, pen-pressure alpha variation and micro-variations in ink colour. The 'Reshuffle look' button re-seeds it for a different random result. Note the tool itself cautions that this is a handwriting-style image, not a scan of real handwriting.

faq.q: How do I export multi-page documents, and will A4 print at the right size?
faq.a: Long text flows onto multiple A4 or Letter pages automatically. You can save the current page as PNG, all pages as a ZIP of PNGs, or all pages as a multi-page PDF (via pdf-lib). The PDF converts canvas pixels at 96 px per inch, so an A4 page prints as true A4 — print at 100% rather than 'fit to page'.

faq.q: Are there quick presets, and is my text saved if I refresh?
faq.a: Yes. Style presets like 'Neat & tidy', 'Exam answer sheet', 'Rushed / late night' and 'Four-line practice' set the font, ink, paper, realism, spacing and margin in one click. Your text and all settings autosave to local storage under handwriting-draft-v1 and are restored on return; 'Clear draft' wipes them.
